---
title: "Factivity accuracy analysis and figures"
output: html_document
---

```{r accuracy-data, include=FALSE}
# Run through render_accuracy.R. There is deliberately no mock/default input.
if(!exists('params')||is.null(params$input_file))stop('Supply an explicit production export.')
source('analysis/R/data.R')
source('analysis/R/factivity_accuracy.R')
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
catalog<-read_accuracy_catalog(repo_root)
export<-read_one_export(params$input_file)
response<-filter(export,mode=='production',trial_role=='response')
stopifnot(nrow(response)>0,all(response$measure=='accuracy'),
          all(response$probe_id=='english-learner-cause-and-burn'),
          all(response$rating_scale_min=='1'),all(response$rating_scale_max=='7'))
imported<-load_ratings(params$input_file,catalog)
ratings<-imported$ratings
stopifnot(n_distinct(ratings$participant)==100,nrow(ratings)==1200)
output<-file.path(repo_root,params$output_dir)
stopifnot(startsWith(paste0(output,'/'),paste0(repo_root,'/analysis/output/')))
dir.create(output,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
mock<-FALSE
# Matrix resampling retains the same percentile bootstrap while avoiding slow
# per-draw R callbacks. Each cell contains one response per participant.
bootstrap_mean<-function(x,B=100000L){
 q<-quantile(colMeans(matrix(sample(x,length(x)*B,TRUE),nrow=length(x))),c(.025,.975),names=FALSE)
 tibble(n=length(x),mean=mean(x),low=q[1],high=q[2])
}
cells<-summarise_ratings(ratings,params$bootstrap_draws)
stats<-accuracy_statistics(ratings,catalog$versions,params$bootstrap_draws)
write_csv(imported$import_audit,file.path(output,'import-audit.csv'))
write_csv(cells,file.path(output,'cell-summary.csv'))
write_csv(stats$versions,file.path(output,'version-statistics.csv'))
write_csv(stats$overall,file.path(output,'overall-statistics.csv'))
write_csv(stats$thick_subject,file.path(output,'thick-subject-contrast.csv'))
write_csv(count(distinct(ratings,participant,verb_condition),verb_condition),file.path(output,'participant-counts.csv'))
```

```{r approved-figure-style, include=FALSE}
# Reuse the approved plotting chunk verbatim; do not regenerate a report or
# execute the original study's data/defaults. Only the measure label differs.
template<-readLines('analysis/figures.Rmd',warn=FALSE)
start<-grep('^```\\{r figure-functions,',template)
end<-which(seq_along(template)>start&template=='```')[1]
plot_code<-paste(template[(start+1):(end-1)],collapse='\n')
plot_code<-sub("y = 'Mean naturalness (1-7)'","y = 'Mean accuracy (1-7)'",plot_code,fixed=TRUE)
eval(parse(text=plot_code))
candidate_labels<-function(study)c(direct='Event (direct)',fact='Fact-denoting')
placement<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(catalog$versions))){
 v<-catalog$versions[i,]; stem<-paste('factivity-accuracy',v$case,v$variant,sep='-')
 save_plot(profile_plot(v),paste0(stem,'-profile'),10,4.1)
 placement[[i]]<-mutate(v,profile_file=paste0(stem,'-profile.png'))
}
write_csv(bind_rows(placement),file.path(output,'figure-placement.csv'))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),file.path(output,'R-session-info.txt'))
print(count(distinct(ratings,participant,verb_condition),verb_condition))
print(filter(stats$versions,metric %in% c('fact_lexical','fact_loss')) %>%
 select(label,metric,thin,thick,difference,low,high,p,p_holm),n=18,width=Inf)
message('Nine production accuracy figures and participant-level statistics saved. No report generated.')
```
